title: SIGTERM mid-run closes the trajectory with agent_stopped(interrupted)
description: The harness sends SIGTERM one second after agent_started, while the model is still writing a long answer. The agent MUST stop its runtime, close any open turn, and end the trajectory with agent_stopped(interrupted) rather than dying with no terminal event. The exit status is not judged.

commission.prompt: Write a detailed 1500-word story about a lighthouse keeper. Do not use any tools.
